summary:
Our project, “Abandoned but Not Forgotten,” is an educational storytelling project that explores the forgotten spacecraft and equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. We developed a creative story featuring C.O.R.A., a futuristic robot historian who discovers important space exploration equipment, including NASA’s Sky Crane and Ingenuity helicopter.

Through storytelling, we explain the history, purpose, and scientific achievements of these machines. Our project transforms scientific information into an interesting adventure that young students can understand and enjoy.

The goal is to raise awareness about space exploration, celebrate technological achievements, and inspire the next generation of scientists, engineers, and astronauts. We believe that even equipment that has completed its mission can leave behind an important legacy.
details:
Our project is an educational storytelling experience designed to teach young students about the history of space exploration and the equipment left behind on Mars and the Moon.

The story follows C.O.R.A. (Cosmic Observation & Retrieval Assistant), a futuristic robot historian in the year 2146. C.O.R.A. explores Mars and discovers historical equipment, including the Sky Crane from NASA’s Perseverance mission and the Ingenuity helicopter.

The project explains how these machines helped advance space exploration. It combines scientific facts with creative storytelling to make complex information easier and more enjoyable to understand.

The main benefit is educating young students about space technology while encouraging curiosity, creativity, and interest in STEM subjects.

Our project is creative because it transforms real historical space missions into an imaginative story. We focused on combining accurate scientific information with characters and storytelling to make learning more engaging.

Our intended impact is to inspire young people to explore science, technology, engineering, and space exploration and to understand the importance of every achievement in human space history.
